comment.body:
The screenshot and the questions about New key, Security key, Device name, and the two Connect buttons are useful. To turn this into an actionable fix, please provide:

1. One numbered scenario focused on Connect: the exact screen state and values entered, what you expected to happen, and what actually happened after clicking the button, including any visible or missing feedback.
2. The result of retrying that same scenario on the latest stable PowerToys release, including the About version.

This will distinguish unclear UX copy or controls from a connection or validation failure and define the acceptance criteria.
